entries.title: Why my brother decided to move to Austria.
entries.body:
My brother is currently working as a waiter at Goldene Kugel in Salzburg, Austria. But why did he come to Austria?

The main reason was because of me. I am currently studying as a pupil in Salzburg, Austria. Since I would be living away from my family, I wanted my brother to be in the same city so that I would have the support of a close family member. With the help of my guardian in Austria, we began searching for a suitable job for my brother.

After about four to five months of searching, he was offered a position as a waiter at Goldene Kugel. Once the employer completed the necessary procedures, my brother received the required employment documents, including the AMS (Austrian Public Employment Service) approval, a work contract, and the necessary supporting documents. These documents were then sent from Austria to India by our guardian so that we could begin preparing his Visa D application.

In our family's situation, having a trusted guardian in Austria was extremely helpful. Our guardian assisted us with communication, collecting documents, and guiding us through the process. However, it is important to understand that every visa or residence permit application is assessed individually by the Austrian authorities. Having a guardian does not guarantee visa approval or faster processing.

If your application includes a guardian or sponsor, the relationship should be genuine and accurately documented. In our case, our guardian had known our family for many years, and we explained this relationship honestly in a supporting letter. You should never misrepresent a guardianship or create one solely to strengthen a visa application.

With my brother's employment secured and all the required documents in hand, we were finally ready to begin the Visa D application process. In the next chapter, I will explain what Visa D is and why it was the correct visa for my brother's journey.

entries.title: Understanding Visa D
entries.body:
Before beginning the application process, it is important to understand what a Visa D is and whether it is the correct visa for your situation.

A Visa D (National Visa) is a long-stay visa issued by Austria that allows eligible foreign nationals to stay in Austria for an extended period, depending on the purpose of their visit and the conditions of the visa. It is commonly issued for purposes such as employment, study, family reunification, or to facilitate entry before obtaining a residence permit, where applicable.

In my brother's case, the Visa D was the appropriate visa because he had received a valid job offer from an Austrian employer and had completed the required pre-application steps. His application was supported by the documents provided by his employer and the relevant Austrian authorities.

Why We Applied for Visa D ?

In my brother's case, we applied Visa D for Seasonal Worker Job. He received waiter job from Salzburg, Austria. As his job period/tenure is of 4 months, Visa D is the only legal option available.

Important Information About Visa D

Visa D (Visum D) is applied for those who intend to live legally in Austria from 91 days till 180 days. There are different types of Visa D: Student Visa, Work/Job Visa and Visitor Visa. Each requires specific documents to pass such as School Admission Letter for Student Visa, AMS and Work Contract for Work Visa, etc.

Documents We Had Before Applying

* Passport (Old and New, if applicable)
* Employment Contract
* AMS Approval
* Passport-size Photographs
* Health Insurance 
* Visa Application Form
* Flight Itinerary
* Emergency Contact Details
* Bank Statements and/or ITR 
* Other supporting documents

To know detail information regarding our Documentation, please refer to the following Chapters.


My Personal Tips

As per my experience at VFS, it's really important to know that you must reach at least 15 minutes before your appointment time starts. This is because of crowd at VFS Global Centre. Also, always recheck all the documents before going for the appointment. 

In order to download Checklist PDF:
  1. Go to: https://visa.vfsglobal.com/ind/en/aut/visa-type
  2. Select your Visa Type
  3. Select "Documents Required"
  4. Click Link text to download updated Checklist PDF by V.F.S.

As per the rules, any documents missing is considered invalid and his/her application is rejected either by V.F.S or the Embassy of Austria. Also, ensure that your full name is same in all documents. If not, issue new Stamp Paper stating about name difference in other documents and that the names refer to yourself. Get it notarized by Local Notary, then give it for Apostille. After apostille, your document is ready. Also, print out 2-3 Black and White copies of the Stamp Paper apostilled and notarized.

Summary

Understanding the purpose of Visa D before submitting an application helps you prepare the correct documents and avoid unnecessary mistakes. In the next chapter, I will explain how we collected every required document before booking the visa appointment.

entries.title: Job offer, employment contract, employer communication, and eligibility.
entries.body:
For most people applying for an Austrian Visa D for employment, securing a genuine job offer is the first and one of the most important steps. Without a valid offer from an eligible employer, it is generally not possible to proceed with the employment-based visa process.

In my brother's case, finding a job required patience and persistence. With the help of our guardian in Austria, we searched for suitable opportunities that matched his skills and experience. The search took approximately four to five months before he was finally offered a position as a waiter at Goldene Kugel in Salzburg.

Once the employer decided to hire him, they began the necessary procedures required under Austrian law. After the required approvals were obtained, my brother received his employment documents, including the work contract and other supporting documents needed for the visa application. These documents were then sent to India so that we could begin preparing his Visa D application.

Every applicant's journey is different. Some people may find employment through online job portals, recruitment agencies, personal contacts, or direct applications to employers. Regardless of how you find a job, always ensure that the employer is genuine and that all employment documents are authentic.

How We Found the Job

As he is having his guardian, he physically visited some hotels and he finally got the hotel in Salzburg. His guardian filled the form and completed everything before my brother arrived in Austria. It's important to send documents like AMS, Work Contract, etc. via Post or E-Mail. For those who don't have a guardian and/or cannot physically visit hotels for employment, they can email them well in advance with C.V. updated and Degree Certificates and other Certificates, if applicable. 

Documents Received from the Employer

☑ Employment Contract
☑ AMS Approval
☑ Security Guarantee
☑ Other Supporting Documents

Official links:

Employer Website: https://www.goldene-kugel.at/

My Personal Tips

Please find you job at the earliest. If job not received yet, contact the Embassy of Austria in New Delhi via E-Mail and Phone Number (+91 112419200). Tell them for the appointment for Job Seeking Visa. After visiting the Embassy for the appointment, they will inform you via E-Mail. After receiving accepted visa, you can visit Austria only for finding the job. After finding job, you have to come back to your home country. Then apply for residence permit and/or Visa.

Summary

Finding the right employer was the foundation of my brother's Visa D journey. Once the employment was confirmed and the required documents were issued, we could move on to preparing the complete visa application. In the next chapter, I will explain how we collected and organized all the required documents before booking the visa appointment.

entries.title: Preparing the Required Documents
entries.body:
After my brother secured his employment, the next step was to prepare all the documents required for the Visa D application. This stage required careful planning because even a small mistake or a missing document could delay the application. We created a checklist and gathered every document one by one, making sure that the information on each document was accurate and consistent.

Some documents were provided by the employer and our guardian in Austria, while others had to be prepared in India. We carefully checked that names, passport numbers, dates of birth, and other personal details matched across every document. Whenever a document required additional clarification or supporting evidence, we prepared it before booking the visa appointment.

It is important to remember that document requirements may vary depending on your nationality, purpose of travel, and the latest instructions issued by the Austrian Embassy or the Visa Application Centre (VFS). For this reason, always refer to the official checklist before submitting your application and avoid relying solely on information from unofficial sources.

Documents Received from Austria

1. A.M.S (Austriamarktservice)

A.M.S is received by the Austrian Government. This document is made after examination and labour test from the Employer. A.M.S can be only made before 2 months of the first working day. Ensure that Work Contract and AMS important contents are same.

2. Work Contract

This document is made by the Employer. It contains detail information about the employment, salary, insurance, etc. It would be better that you have original Work Contract with physical signature of the employer with Stamp sent via Post (Austria Post).

Click Me for posting via Austria Post.

3. Guardian Consent Letter

This document is for those who is having their guardian in Austria. It's necessary to attach Guardian's Passport and/or ID. It would be good that the document should be Original and that guardian has signed physically.

4. Insurance 

This document is created automatically/manually by the Employer. If manually, you and/or the Employer will visit OGK Insurance Office. OGK is the public health Insurance in Austria. After submitting necessary documents, your insurance has started. 

Important to note that short-term insurance is necessary for the duration of a month while travelling from India to Austria.  Click Me to apply for short-term insurance. Ensure that OGK Insurance starts before the end of short-term insurance, and there is no gap between these two.

In case of Guardian financially sponsoring you:

5. Declaration of Liability

This document must be filled by the Guardian or yourself. Also, this document must be notarized by the Local Notary in Austria. Click Here to download this document. After notarizing and signing, send it to India via Post.

6. Bank Statements of Guardian

It is mandatory to have bank statements of at least 6 months from the guardian to prevent questioning and more scrutiny. This document should be stamped by the respective bank of guardian.

7. Salary Slips

It is also mandatory to have salary slips of Guardian. If necessary, sign of the employer is also better.

8. Accommodation Proof of Guardian

In order to know whether the guardian is legally residing in Austria or not, it is mandatory to present to them residence documents of your guardian. It is not necessary to show them originals but Black and White copies should be ready.

Documents Prepared in India

1. Passport 

This document is very important. To apply for new/re-issued passport, Click Here !

To know what documents to submit, Click Here for New or Click Here for Re-Issue !
To get Annexures, Click Here !

After successful appointment, wait for some time until passport reaches your home. After receiving, check all details and ensure that your passport is stamped by the Regional Passport Officer or its assistant. If details are incorrect, inform to the RPO Office immediately.

Click Here to talk to our expert regarding submission of documents for new/re-issued passport.

2. Application Form

This document is mandatory for Visa D.  This document describes your trip. This document can either be typed or handwritten. It must be signed physically by the Applicant. Stick ICAO Photo on the given box of PHOTO. Fill only what it is given to you. Don't fill some sections, only officers are allowed to write.

Click Here to know the instructions as to how to capture your photo in ICAO standard under "Photo Specifications".
Click Here to receive Application Form or Click Here to go under "Download Form".
Click Here to receive Consent Form or Click Here to go under "Download Form".

3. Checklist Document

This document presents documents that are required for various visas D, such as Student, Work and Visitor. This document is also mandatory and must be named and signed physically by the Applicant. Check the list according to your visa needed : Visitor Visa, Student Visa, Work Visa.

4. Aadhar Card

This document is an Identity Document (ID). This is also deemed necessary to know your real identity.
Click Here to apply for new/updated Aadhar Card or searched "Aadhar Card" in Google Search.
It is necessary to print out full E-Aadhar Card PDF Form, not cut-out card Xerox. That is not acceptable. 

5. Cover Letter

This document states regarding your stay and everything that will happen. Click Here to apply for Cover Letter.

My Personal Checklist

  1. Appointment Receipt
  2. Completed Visa application form
  3. Valid passport (original)
  4. Passport photocopies (all relevant pages)
  5. ICAO photographs - 2 Quantity
  6. Cover letter / motivation letter
  7. Curriculum Vitae
  8. Birth Certificate (Translated)
  9. Notary: Name Clarification of Shineil
  10. Notary: Name Clarification of my Father
  11. Police Clearance Certificate
  12. Guardian’s Passport
  13. Residence Documents from Guardian
  14. Parental Consent Letter 
  15. Guardian Consent Letter 
  16. Admission Letter from Austrian school
  17. SSC Mark Sheet
  18. Leaving Certificate
  19. Accommodation Letter from School
  20. Bestatigung (School)
  21. Bestatigung (Guardian)
  22. Meldezettel
  23. Declaration of Liability
  24. Bank Statements
  25. Salary Slip
  26. Health Insurance (Short and Long)
  27. Travel Itinerary & Flight Ticket
  28. Emergency Contact Details
  29. Aadhar Card & PAN Card
  30. Online Vault
  31. Baptism Certificate
  32. Visa fee payment receipt
  33. Other Documents (if any)

My Notes

Before following my checklist, check official site of Austrian Government, Embassy, etc. After cross-checking and found that these are valid, them follow my checklist. Don't forget to print out 1 copy of Colour each document and 2 copies of Black and White each document.

Summary

By carefully preparing every required document, we felt confident before booking the visa appointment. In the next chapter, I will describe how we scheduled the appointment and what to expect on the day of submission.

entries.title: Appointment scheduling, VFS process, and preparation tips.
entries.body:
Once all the required documents were prepared, the next important step was to book an appointment for submitting my brother's Visa D application. At this stage, it is important to carefully check which authority is responsible for accepting your application, because the procedure can vary depending on your country of residence and the type of visa you are applying for.

For my brother's application, we checked the official Austrian visa information and followed the instructions for applicants in India. We then selected the appropriate appointment category and provided the required personal information while booking the appointment.

Before confirming the appointment, we carefully checked the applicant's name, passport details, visa category, date, time, and location. It is important to enter these details correctly because mistakes can create unnecessary problems later.

Once the appointment was successfully booked, we saved the confirmation and kept both a digital and printed copy. We also used the time before the appointment to review the entire document file again and make sure that nothing was missing.

Our Appointment Details

Application Type: Visa D – Employment

  1. Applicant: Kevin Mathias (exactly as in Passport )
  2. Appointment Date: 14.07.2026
  3. Appointment Time: 12:45 PM
  4. Location: VFS Pune, Fatima Nagar, Pune, MH, IND.
  5. Appointment Reference Number (example ): AUT/___/__/_____/__

How We Booked the Appointment

As per VFS Rules, applicants are requested to book an online appointment at VFS around India and the world. 
Click Here for booking an appointment.
Keep your Passport and money ready for booking an appointment. Fill it exactly as in Passport. Pay money and your appointment booking is confirmed. You will receive Appointment Confirmation Letter and Consent Form in E-Mail that you provided while booking. 
Regarding optional services, use Premium Services only when you need it. This does not guarantee your visa decision. It would be okay that don't waste your money on Premium Services. Normal is fine. Use SMS Updates as per my opinion because it gives you Live Updates about your application. Also, use Deliver My Application if you are unable to go to VFS Application Centre. Other services are not quite useful unless you are specifically in need of it.
After paying and receiving 2 PDFs, print it out each copy and bring these documents with other documents for appointment.

Things We Checked Before Confirming

  1. Correct visa category
  2. Correct applicant details
  3. Correct passport number and its details
  4. Correct appointment location
  5. Correct date and time
  6. Appointment confirmation printed
  7. Required and optional documents ready

My Personal Experience

Kindly check the appointment details. Even if one thing is incorrect, kindly edit it or contact with VFS Employees. Don't waste your money with optional services. Don't forget to bring it on the Appointment Day.

Summary

After the appointment was booked, the application became much more real. We now had a fixed date on which my brother would submit his documents and officially begin the next stage of his Visa D journey. In the next chapter, I will describe what happened on the actual day of the visa submission.
